# svg-slides set: Boardroom (`boardroom`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Generic consulting style: navy plus one bright accent per slide, serif titles over sans body, one-sentence titles under a thin rule, a six-square agenda tracker, chart-left / insight-right 60:40 content, "so what" box. Not any firm's template or brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set boardroom --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- deckary.com PowerPoint design guide (from 300+ consulting decks): three colour roles, accent on one element per slide, 28 to 36 pt titles, data + insight layout with the chart at about 60 percent, 15 to 20 percent whitespace.
- SlideSpeak consulting-style prompts (unofficial): deep navy headings in a serif, one electric-blue takeaway accent per slide, titles under 15 words above a thin grey rule, agenda tracker of small squares.

Fonts: head `Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, serif`; sans `Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`. Token names are palette
slots, not literal hues: `--teal` is this set's primary. `--block` / `--on-block` are the
colour-block fill and the text on it (`--ink` / `--on-ink` likewise for a reversed field). Inlined svg-library components pick up the same palette.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: full navy field; accent rule and tracked eyebrow, a two-line serif title, a sans subtitle, a thin rule above the meta line, and a small four-bar rising chart motif (last bar in the accent) on the right. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: a navy left panel holds the chapter number in serif; on white, the six-square agenda tracker (current square filled), eyebrow, a two-line serif section title under an accent rule and a sans orientation line. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: an accent bar runs beside a three-line serif statement in navy, the tracked eyebrow above, a thin rule and a source-style attribution below; quiet grey corner ticks frame the block. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Data + insight slide: eyebrow, a one-line serif action title over a thin grey rule, tracker top right; the graphic fills the left 60% with a source line under it, the body text and a navy "so what" box take the right 40%. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: eyebrow and a one-line serif action title over a thin grey rule, tracker top right, a large graphic slot, and a pale accent-tinted takeaway card with an accent top edge on the right. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: full navy field, accent rule, a two-line serif title, up to three sans contact lines, a thin rule above the meta line and the cover's rising-bar motif on the right. |
